reason: I'd download it and use the 3 free fragments a day, maybe start the 7-day trial and cancel before it charges. For an interview I'm more worried about what I say than how I pronounce each sound, and ChatGPT voice already lets me practise answers for free.
objection: I don't believe an app can really score every sound accurately, and even if it can, pronunciation is only part of passing an interview. Paying $5 a month on my salary for pronunciation only feels like too much when free tools cover most of it.
would_change_my_mind: If people in my IELTS Telegram chats showed that the scores matched their real speaking results, and there was a one-time cheap pass for the 1–2 months until my interview instead of a subscription.
